card_last4.description: last 4 digits of the holder's card

closing_date.description: closing date printed on the statement, YYYY-MM-DD

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the statement, BRL when omitted

dry_run.description: true to validate and review the reading without recording anything

due_date.description: due date printed on the statement, YYYY-MM-DD

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF in hexadecimal, only if you can compute it

issuer.description: card issuer as printed, such as the bank name

items.description: every line of the statement, in the order printed

amount.description: amount of the line in the statement currency, as a positive canonical decimal such as 32.97; kind says whether it adds or subtracts

card_last4.description: last 4 digits of the card of this line when it is not the holder's (additional or virtual card)

components.description: principal, interest, IOF and fee of the line, only when the statement details them

amount.description: canonical decimal in the statement currency

included.description: true when this amount is part of the item amount; false when it is charged apart in another line

confirm_distinct.description: true when a possible_match candidate is a different purchase

date.description: date printed on the line, YYYY-MM-DD; take the year from the statement cycle

defer_match.description: true when you cannot decide on a possible_match now: Lastro records it apart, pending clarification, and opens a possible_match question for Rudolfo

description.description: short readable description in Portuguese; the original description when omitted

direction.description: only for adjustment and unknown: debit when the line adds to the total, credit when it subtracts

excerpt.description: the text of the line exactly as printed, so Rudolfo can find it in his PDF

future_installments.description: only when the statement prints the next installments of this same purchase; never project them yourself

amount.description: amount printed for it, canonical decimal in the statement currency

number.description: installment number, after the one charged on this line

installment_number.description: n of n/N; required for installment and pix_installment

kind.description: what the line is; previous balance goes in previous_balance, not here

merchant.description: store or payee, only when the line shows it

original_amount.description: amount in the foreign currency, for international lines

original_description.description: the description exactly as printed on the line

page.description: page of the PDF where the line is printed, starting at 1

purpose.description: only when Rudolfo told you why

question.description: for unknown: what to ask Rudolfo, in Portuguese

refund_of_id.description: for refund: the purchase it returns money from

related_transaction_id.description: existing transaction that is this same charge (from the conversation or a notification)

missing.description: for a partial reading: what you could not read, in Portuguese

page_count.description: number of pages of the PDF

period_end.description: last day of the cycle, when printed

period_start.description: first day of the cycle, when printed

previous_balance.description: total of the previous statement as printed in the summary, when shown

reading.description: complete when you read every line of every page; partial otherwise

reading_doubts.description: passages you could not interpret safely

excerpt.description: the text you could not read safely, as printed

page.description: page of the PDF, starting at 1

question.description: what to ask Rudolfo, in Portuguese

total.description: total of this statement as printed, canonical decimal; negative only for a credit balance
